title: Nova Havens blog post (writer output)
description: Structured output of the post-writer model. Mirrors the BlogPost shape in apps/web/src/content/blog.ts and the validation gate in docs/blog-automation/PLAN.md section 8. Kept strict and flat for the n8n structured-output parser.

slug.description: URL slug: kebab-case, unique across apps/web/src/content/blog.ts and apps/web/content/posts/, contains the primary keyword, no dates.

title.description: Post title. Target 60 characters or fewer; 70 is the hard limit. Primary keyword in the first half.

category.description: Site blog category. Automation uses only 'For Displaced Families' and 'Market Guides'; 'For Insurance Professionals' exists on the site but is not written to by the automation.

excerpt.description: Meta description and social card text. 80-160 characters. States the answer, contains the primary keyword.

motif.description: Open Graph image motif (BlogPostMotif in blog.ts). checklist=guides, map=disaster/regional, house=housing comparisons, key=property-owner topics, magnifier=trends/research, gears=process, paw=pets, ai=automation topics only.

cta.description: Closing call-to-action card (BlogPostCta in blog.ts). housing=family-facing, property=owner-facing, none=industry roundups or phone-only actions.

content.description: Post body in the house markdown subset rendered by apps/web/src/components/blog/post-body.tsx. Must start with a '> ' quick-summary block, contain at least 3 '## ' question headings, and end with '## Frequently Asked Questions' followed by 3-5 '**Question?**' blocks. 900-1,500 words (800-1,700 accepted by the validator). No links, HTML, tables or images.

sources.description: Primary sources cited by name in the body. Allow-listed domains only. May be empty for evergreen guides.

name.description: Source as named in the body, e.g. 'National Weather Service, Hurricane Local Statement' or 'FEMA Disaster Declaration DR-4899-LA'.

url.description: HTTPS URL on an allow-listed domain (subdomains permitted): novahavens.com, weather.gov, fema.gov, census.gov, hud.gov, ready.gov, redcross.org.

accessed.description: Date the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD.
